name: Dakotasuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Pholidosauridae while English Wikipedia calls it a goniopholidid; placed in Pholidosauridae as in PBDB.
sum: Dakotasuchus is a mesoeucrocodylian from the Cenomanian Dakota Sandstone of Kansas and the Cedar Mountain Formation of Utah.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens from the Dakota and Cedar Mountain formations.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Mehl 1941
